mentions.name: Robotics Hello World
mentions.description: This project implements the ACT model to train a robot arm on simple pick-and-place tasks, leaning heavily on HuggingFace's LeRobot library while using its own model implementation and training loop.
mentions.source_excerpt: Robotics Hello World: Objective is to implement ACT model to train my arm robot on simple pick-and-place tasks. Leaning heavily on HuggingFace's LeRobot library, but stopping short of using their model implementation and training loop.
